title: PDF 電子收據生成 + SES 郵件發送 (後端)
content: 後端部分：實作 @react-pdf/renderer 收據模板（三語）、PDF 密碼保護（pdf-lib）、S3 儲存、SES 郵件發送。觸發點為管理員核准報名（PATCH /api/admin/enrolments/[id] APPROVE）。

findings: SES client singleton created: src/lib/aws.ts exports sesClient, sesFromAddress
SES region configured as ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) in APP_SES_REGION
SES from address configured as lmcconsultancy.systems@gmail.com in APP_SES_FROM_ADDRESS
Amplify IAM service role handles SES credentials — no hardcoded access keys needed
evidence.residual: No receipt generation code (@react-pdf/renderer, pdf-lib not yet installed). No SES send-email implementation. npm install pending.

acceptance: PDF receipt template via @react-pdf/renderer — bilingual ZH+EN, includes LMC letterhead, receipt number, registrant name, course name, fee, payment date, LMC stamp
Receipt number format: RCPT-{YYYY}-{NNNNN}, auto-incrementing, stored in Registrant.receiptNumber in DB
PDF password-protected via pdf-lib with registrant's idDocNumber as password
Triggered on admin PATCH /api/admin/enrolments/[id] APPROVE — auto-generate PDF, store in S3, update DB
SES email via nodemailer: bilingual subject/body (ZH+EN), PDF as attachment, to registrant's email, BCC admin
Error handling: if SES fails, receipt PDF still stored in S3 and DB — log failure, do not roll back approval
Template generates receipt text in the locale matching the enrollee's preferred language
files: src/lib/receipt/generate.ts (new — @react-pdf/renderer template + S3 upload + pdf-lib lock)
src/lib/email/send.ts (new — SES transport from src/lib/aws.ts, bilingual template)
src/app/api/admin/enrolments/[id]/route.ts (update — trigger receipt generation + SES on approve)
verification: Admin approves enrolment → PDF generated in S3 (password locked with idDocNumber), receiptNumber set in DB, email received with PDF attachment in correct locale. PDF opens with idDocNumber as password.
